name: Tithe In The New Testament
overview: The New Testament affirms the ongoing significance of tithing within God's covenant, as Jesus declared He came not to abolish the Law but to fulfill it, which includes the practice of giving (Matthew 5:17). While Jesus rebuked the Pharisees for neglecting justice, mercy, and faithfulness even as they meticulously tithed their herbs (Matthew 23:23), He also emphasized sincere giving without seeking human praise (Matthew 6:1). The principle of generous and measured giving is further encouraged with the promise of abundant blessing (Luke 6:38), echoing the Old Testament call to bring tithes into the storehouse to honor God and receive His provision (Malachi 3:8, 10).
